title: Personal Sender Account Tenure Goodwill on Mobile Wallet Shortfalls
content:
Loyalty recognition terms: long-standing customers receive a fixed goodwill amount when a **Mobile Wallet** credit arrives short.

**Tenure goodwill.** The tenure goodwill on a shortfall make-good follows the whole calendar months from the opened date of the customer's Personal Sender Account to today:

| Whole calendar months the Personal Sender Account has been open | Tenure goodwill (USD) |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 3.00 |
| at least 36 and fewer than 60 | 1.50 |
| fewer than 36 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 2026-08-12)

| Personal Sender Account opened | Whole months | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| 2021-08-12 | 60 | 3.00 |
| 2021-08-13 | 59 | 1.50 |
| 2023-08-12 | 36 | 1.50 |
| 2023-08-13 | 35 | nothing |
